Strategy: Net Reserve Stands at $35 Billion, All Bitcoin Holdings Unencumbered

Strategy said its Net Reserve now stands at $35 billion, with all of its bitcoin holdings unencumbered. During the 2022 bear market, its Net Reserve was negative and one-third of its BTC was pledged as collateral. The company said it survived that downturn and emerged stronger, adding that its "conviction and optionality have never been stronger." — link

BTC Falls Below $60,000, ETH Drops Below $1,700 as 24H Liquidations Reach $1.57B

According to Binance market data, BTC fell below $60,000 and is trading at $59,378.87, with a 24-hour low of $58,768.73. ETH dropped below $1,700 and is trading at $1,644.13, with a 24-hour low of $1,624.37. Coinbase: Only the US Dollar Gained Over the Past Month, While Crypto Performed Worst

According to Coinbase Institutional's November 20 weekly report, the US dollar was the only gainer among 14 tracked assets and market benchmarks over the 30 days through November 18, rising 2.5%. Bitcoin and Ethereum recorded the largest losses, falling 24.0% and 26.5%, respectively. Gold declined 10.2%, the Nasdaq 100 fell 6.4%, and the S&P 500 dropped 4.3%. Coinbase attributed Bitcoin's weakness primarily to rising real yields and expectations of further Fed rate hikes. — link
